title: Practice 4: Verbs that take the instrumental

blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: Я горжусь ___ (своя скромность).
exercises.prompt: I pride myself on my humility.
exercises.why: «гордиться» takes the instrumental. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: The president made use of his veto.
exercises.why: «воспользоваться» takes the instrumental. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Я интересуюсь ___ (география).
exercises.why: «интересоваться» takes the instrumental. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: You do not have all the information.
exercises.why: «обладать» takes the instrumental. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Дышать ___ (дизельные выхлопы) вредно для вашего здоровья.
exercises.prompt: Inhaling diesel exhaust is bad for our health.
exercises.why: «дышать» takes the instrumental. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Soap has the property of removing dirt.
exercises.why: «обладать» takes the instrumental. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Если ты можешь воспользоваться ___ (сила) притяжения, то сделай это.
exercises.prompt: If you can use gravity to your advantage, do so.
exercises.why: «воспользоваться» takes the instrumental. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Tom wondered how Mary felt.
exercises.why: «интересоваться» takes the instrumental. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Он очень гордится ___ (свои навыки) пилотирования.
exercises.prompt: He is very proud of his skill as a pilot.
exercises.why: «гордиться» takes the instrumental. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Don't mess around!
exercises.why: «заниматься» takes the instrumental. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Когда я готовлю спагетти, я пользуюсь ___ (таймер) для варки яиц.
exercises.prompt: Whenever I cook spaghetti noodles, I set an egg timer.
exercises.why: «пользоваться» takes the instrumental. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: She manages a shoe store.
exercises.why: «управлять» takes the instrumental. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Я восхищаюсь ___ (твоё бесстрашие).
exercises.why: «восхищаться» takes the instrumental. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: In order to farm in this arid area, artificial irrigation is necessary.
exercises.ru: Чтобы заниматься ___ в этой засушливой местности, необходимо искусственное орошение.
exercises.why: «заниматься» takes the instrumental. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Моя дочь занимается ___ (бальные танцы) с четырёх лет.
exercises.prompt: My daughter has been doing ballroom dancing since she was four years old.
exercises.why: «заниматься» takes the instrumental. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Wendy was not always interested in Japanese festivals.
exercises.why: «интересоваться» takes the instrumental. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Кредиторы наслаждаются ___ (прибыльный период).
exercises.prompt: Money lenders are enjoying a profitable period.
exercises.why: «наслаждаться» takes the instrumental. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Он свободно владеет ___ (фарси).
exercises.why: «владеть» takes the instrumental. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Дэниэл любовался ___ (океан) из окна своей комнаты в отеле.
exercises.prompt: Daniel was admiring the ocean from the window of his hotel room.
exercises.why: «любоваться» takes the instrumental. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Women use perfume because a nose is easier to tempt than an eye.
exercises.ru: Женщины пользуются ___, потому что проще обольстить нос, чем глаз.
exercises.why: «пользоваться» takes the instrumental. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
